# Which few queries are behind most of your Postgres load?

> Free pg_stat_statements analyzer: run one read-only query, paste the result, and see which Postgres queries use the most database time, which look like N+1 loops, and which miss cache or spill to disk. Runs in your browser, never touches your database.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
